class ExactStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = [
            self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        ]

        self.spy = self.symbols[0]
        self.aapl = self.symbols[1]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.spy_last_close = None
        self.spy_last_sma = None
        self.aapl_last_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        prior_spy_close = self.spy_last_close
        prior_spy_sma = self.spy_last_sma
        prior_aapl_close = self.aapl_last_close

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
            self.spy_last_close = spy_bar.Close
            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.spy_last_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

            if prior_aapl_close is not None and aapl_bar.Close < prior_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_last_close = aapl_bar.Close

        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0:
            if (prior_spy_close is not None and prior_spy_sma is not None and
                    prior_spy_close >= prior_spy_sma and spy_close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value):
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        else:
            if (prior_spy_close is not None and prior_spy_sma is not None and
                    prior_spy_close <= prior_spy_sma and spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value):
                quantity = self.CalculateOrderQuantity(self.spy, 0.40)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0:
            if self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0
        else:
            if self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 // aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
            prior_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
            prior_close = self.previous_spy_close

            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = prior_sma
        else:
            self.previous_spy_close = None
            self.previous_spy_sma = None

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close
        else:
            self.previous_aapl_close = None
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close

        if (
            self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
        ):
            crossed_above = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value

                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            )

            if self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity == 0 and crossed_above:
                self.SetHoldings(self.spy, 0.40)

            if self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity != 0 and crossed_below:
                self.Liquidate(self.spy)

        if self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Quantity == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:

            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:

            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
        ):
            self.Liquidate(self.aapl)

from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentSlotsAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.aapl = self.add_equity("AAPL", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.ibm = self.add_equity("IBM", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.bac = self.add_equity("BAC", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.aig = self.add_equity("AIG", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS)

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if data.bars.contains_key(symbol):
                bar = data.bars[symbol]

                if symbol == self.spy:
                    self.spy_closes.add(bar.close)

                if symbol == self.aapl:
                    if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                        if bar.close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                            self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                        else:
                            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

                    self.previous_aapl_close = bar.close
                    self.aapl_rsi.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)

        if any(not data.bars.contains_key(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if not self.spy_closes.is_ready or not self.aapl_rsi.is_ready:
            return

        spy_bar = data.bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.bars[self.aapl]

        spy_sma_today = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
        spy_sma_yesterday = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0

        spy_crosses_above = (
            self.spy_closes[1] <= spy_sma_yesterday
            and self.spy_closes[0] > spy_sma_today
        )
        spy_crosses_below = (
            self.spy_closes[1] >= spy_sma_yesterday
            and self.spy_closes[0] < spy_sma_today
        )

        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        elif self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            target_value = self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40
            quantity = int(target_value // spy_bar.close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.market_order(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60:
            self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0
        elif (
            self.strategy_b_shares == 0
            and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            and self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000
        ):
            quantity = int(20_000 // aapl_bar.close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.market_order(self.aapl, quantity)
                self.strategy_b_shares = quantity
